rows.en: This woman wants to buy a book.

rows.ru: Я говорю ей об одной новой книге.
rows.en: I tell her about one new book.
It is the newest book here.
The woman gave me the money.
We have no more books.
It is the last day in Moscow.
We are waiting in front of the door.
How long have we been here?

rows.ru: Не знаю, ждёт ли она нас.
rows.en: I do not know whether she is waiting for us.

rows.ru: Вот она, уже идёт к двери.
rows.en: There she is, already coming to the door.

rows.ru: Моя семья живёт в большом доме.
rows.en: My family lives in a big house.
The house is in the city.
Mum is not at home right now.
She has gone out to get water.
The girl at the door is waiting for her.

core5:3.title: A job at a Russian company

rows.ru: Я получил работу в русской компании.
rows.en: I got a job at a Russian company.
The company in question is in Moscow.

rows.ru: Скажите, пожалуйста, все там говорят на русском?
rows.en: Tell me, please, does everyone speak Russian there?

rows.ru: Да, там нужно знать русский язык.
rows.en: Yes, you need to know Russian there.

rows.ru: Через минуту я буду знать больше.
rows.en: In a minute I will know more.

rows.ru: Мы не можем найти эту улицу.
rows.en: We cannot find this street.

rows.ru: Девушка на улице говорит с нами.
rows.en: A girl in the street is talking to us.

rows.ru: Она знает, где находится наш дом.
rows.en: She knows where our house is.
We found the house in a minute.
Here is our door.
How are you feeling?
My leg hurts.
The skin on my leg hurts too.
A sick person cannot work.
I really want to be healthy.
My right shoulder hurts.

rows.ru: Эта боль у меня каждый день.
rows.en: I have this pain every day.
I cannot feel my right hand.
There is no blood, and that is good.
My tooth hurts as well.

rows.ru: У меня головная боль каждый день.
rows.en: I have a headache every day.
My back and knee hurt too.
My whole body feels this pain.

rows.ru: Врач говорит, что нужно больше воды.
rows.en: The doctor says I need more water.

rows.ru: Друг поддержал меня и дал воды.
rows.en: A friend held me up and gave me water.
The child has a stomach ache.
The doctor will treat him.

rows.ru: Ребёнок мёрзнет и не чувствует пальцев.
rows.en: The child is freezing and cannot feel his fingers.
He held out his hand to the doctor.

rows.ru: Врач сказал, что это не большая проблема.
rows.en: The doctor said it is not a big problem.

rows.ru: Сегодня я иду к зубному врачу.
rows.en: Today I am going to the dentist.

rows.ru: Я заболел, и горло очень болит.
rows.en: I have fallen ill, and my throat hurts a lot.
My stomach hurts every day too.

rows.ru: Я не могу сдерживать эту боль.
rows.en: I cannot keep holding this pain in.

rows.ru: Но врач говорит, что вреда для здоровья нет.
rows.en: But the doctor says there is no harm to my health.
The doctor said my heart is healthy.
Today it is not letting me down.

rows.ru: Но я не мог сдержать боль в груди.
rows.en: But I could not hold back the pain in my chest.
The child's little leg hurts too.
Mum is waiting for us by the door.

nature:0.title: A warm day by the river

rows.en: The sun is very warm today.
We are walking by the river.
The water in the river is still cold.
Beyond the river stand tall trees.
We really want to see the sea.
The weather is sunny today.
What is the temperature right now?
In summer the sea here is very warm.
But the wind is cold already.
One tree has fallen into the street.
We are standing on the river bank.

rows.ru: Снег уже на траве и на камнях.
rows.en: There is snow on the grass and on the stones already.
The leaves have fallen into the cold water.
The island in the river is very big.
We want to walk there in the summer.
It has been raining all day today.

rows.ru: Мороза нет, но на реке ещё лёд.
rows.en: There is no frost, but there is still ice on the river.
In spring it is always like this here.

rows.ru: Летом на берегу будет тёплый песок.
rows.en: In summer the sand on the shore will be warm.
And for now the child has fallen asleep at home.

rows.ru: Мы гуляем в лесу каждый день.
rows.en: We walk in the forest every day.
Beyond the forest there is a big lake.
There is a beach on its shore.

rows.ru: В горах мы нашли горячий источник.
rows.en: In the mountains we found a hot spring.
We love the nature of this region.
There is thick fog on the field today.
The grass is very wet from the rain.

rows.ru: Холод идёт с реки и с озера.
rows.en: Cold air is coming off the river and the lake.
We do not want to walk here.
Mum is waiting for us at home.
My friend is in hospital right now.
The doctor said it is a virus.

rows.ru: Эта болезнь — не самая большая проблема.
rows.en: This illness is not the biggest problem.
The operation will be in a day.
The patient is waiting for the doctor by the door.

rows.ru: В больнице мне дали новое лекарство.
rows.en: At the hospital they gave me a new medicine.

rows.ru: Одна таблетка каждый день после работы.
rows.en: One tablet every day after work.

rows.ru: Доктор говорит, что лечение уже идёт.
rows.en: The doctor says the treatment is already under way.

rows.ru: У меня нет травмы и повреждений.
rows.en: I have no injury and no damage.

rows.ru: Вакцина от этого вируса уже есть.
rows.en: There is already a vaccine for this virus.
The clinic is on our street.
There they told me my diagnosis.
The first symptom came a day later.
Now I am already getting better.
Medicine can do a great deal these days.
